Senior Business Analyst | Mar 2024 – Jun 2025
Led Azure Databricks migration from VPCX 1.0 to VPCX 2.0. • Gather business requirements and manage backlog prioritization. • Led UAT, release validation, and production signoffs.
Managed Data Governance intake, data classification, and ingestion approvals. • Conducted stakeholder workshops, user training, and change management initiatives.
ACCENTURE
Senior Business Analyst | Aug 2020 – Sep 2023
Led business analysis for Capital Markets applications supporting Trade Lifecycle
Management.
Worked on GLOSS application enhancements covering Equities, Fixed Income,
and Derivatives.
Performed requirements gathering, functional analysis, process mapping, and
impact analysis.
Supported trade capture, booking, validation, clearing, settlement, reconciliation,
and exception management.
Coordinated UAT, defect management, and production deployments. • Created BRDs, functional specifications, SOPs, user stories, and Confluence documentation.
Collaborated with business stakeholders, product owners, and technology teams in
Agile delivery.
ICICI BANK
Deputy Manager | Jul 2019 – Jul 2020
Led change management initiatives for enterprise applications. • Performed SQL-based data validation and quality assurance. • Managed project documentation and stakeholder communication. • Supported system enhancements and business process improvements.
WIPRO
Senior Analyst | Feb 2017 – Jul 2019
Worked as a Functional Business Analyst supporting Investment Banking
applications.
Worked across Equities, Fixed Income, and Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD). • Supported Trade Lifecycle Management including trade booking, confirmation, allocation, clearing, settlement, and reconciliation.
Performed requirement analysis, data mapping, UAT, and defect management. • Participated in Agile ceremonies and maintained project documentation.
State Street HCL Services Ltd.
Specialist | Feb 2016 – Jan 2017 • Likely Responsibilities (Resume Version) • Supported the Trade Lifecycle Management (TLM) reconciliation application used for post-trade processing.
Performed reconciliation between trading system feeds and custodian bank feeds,
ensuring trade data matched across systems.
Validated inbound trade files for completeness, accuracy, and timely processing before

reconciliation. Investigated reconciliation breaks by analyzing unmatched or failed trades and identifying root causes.
Worked with business users and technology teams to resolve reconciliation exceptions
and improve data quality.
Conducted functional testing and UAT for application enhancements and production
releases.
Created and updated functional documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles. • Monitored production issues, coordinated incident resolution, and ensured SLA compliance.
Supported data integrity across upstream and downstream applications used in trade
processing.
COGNIZANT (UBS CLIENT)
Senior Team Member | 2014 – Jan 2016
Supported Investment Banking applications for UBS.
Worked on AML, KYC, FATCA, and Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD). • Participated in application migration, UAT, and business validation activities. • Conducted AML, KYC, and FATCA compliance reviews. • Upgraded and migrated fund accounting applications. • Led UAT activities for performance testing and client validation. • Acted as communication bridge between end-users and IT teams. • Worked on ETD (Exchange-Traded Derivatives) Clearing Systems, supporting trade reconciliation and margin processing.
Coordinated with clearing brokers to ensure timely trade settlement and regulatory
reporting
Officer – Reconciliation Team
Karvy Computershare Pvt. Ltd. | March 2012 – January 2014
Generated daily reconciliation and risk management reports. • Onboarded new institutional clients, managing data integration. • Provided IT support and resolved client issues efficiently.
